record_title: Cohomological contraction and a Floquet edge in the trigonometric Nosé–Hoover flow
provenance: A source-specific refinement of the trigonometric Nosé–Hoover flow introduced in arXiv:2609.19958v1: exact phase-space contraction cohomology and a Floquet/Hill analysis of its central periodic orbit.
limitations: The exact identities require b nonzero and concern the source model and its central periodic orbit. The numerical Floquet edge at b=1/2 is high-accuracy floating-point evidence, not an interval-certified theorem, and it does not by itself prove the global chaotic transition. General reversible-dynamics and periodic-damping results are prior art.
